description: Oil-painting style scene. Sailors in white and navy uniforms row wooden boats and leap onto a stone quay, several holding bolt-action rifles. Behind them a steam warship with black smoke from its funnels and a small flag on the mast sits offshore, with other grey ships further off. On the right a massive stone fortress tower rises, and a city with domes and minarets sits on the skyline. Smoke and spray hang in the air. No readable text, and the painting runs edge to edge.
